version.changelog:
Initial release of Gaode Map All-in-One skill (v2.0.0):

- Provides full-featured Gaode (Amap) map tools: POI search, route planning, weather, bus, and real-time traffic.
- Supports geocoding, reverse geocoding, IP geolocation, and smart input suggestions.
- Multiple command-line scripts and usage examples included in documentation.
- Requires personal Amap API Key for access and daily quota limits apply.
- JSON output supported for all commands.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: amap-search-skill
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle is a legitimate tool for interacting with the Gaode Map (Amap) Web Service API. The Python scripts (gaode_map.py and poi_search.py) use the standard library's urllib to perform POI searches, geocoding, route planning, and weather queries against official endpoints (restapi.amap.com). There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and requirements match its stated purpose (Amap/Gaode mapping APIs); it asks the user to provide their own Amap API key and only makes requests to official Amap endpoints.

dimensions.detail: Name/description promise POI, routing, weather, traffic, etc. The included Python scripts call Amap (restapi.amap.com) endpoints for ip, geocoding, place search, routing, weather, traffic, and tips—exactly what the description claims.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs running the shipped Python scripts with a user-provided API key. The instructions do not request unrelated files, system credentials, or background data collection. The scripts only read CLI args and call Amap REST APIs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only), which is low risk. However, the skill does include two Python scripts in the package; running those scripts will execute code locally. No external/download installs, third‑party package installs, or obscure URLs are used.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. It requires the user to supply an Amap API key at runtime (via CLI argument), which is proportional and expected. The code does not attempt to read other env vars or config files.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request permanent/global presence (always:false) and does not modify other skills or system settings. It runs on demand when invoked.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be what it claims: a local Python wrapper around the Amap (Gaode) Web APIs. Before using it, provide your own Amap API key (do not share it publicly). Be aware that queries (including any coordinates or IP-based location) are sent to Amap's servers and will be visible to that service. If you want extra caution, review the two included Python files (gaode_map.py and poi_search.py) yourself, run them in a restricted environment, and avoid putting your API key into shared logs or public repositories. Also check Amap's quota and billing rules for your key to avoid unexpected rate limits or charges.
